messages:
cooper: saw an OOM incident on runtime-boxpool-3 at ~02:05 UTC. Trace points at compaction + a cluster of pinned small-span allocations. Opening thread to turn PM follow-ups into tracked owners/timeline. :mag:

mira: Thanks. From PM action list: short-term guardrails (compaction concurrency cap + abort-on-low-mem), medium-term RCA (heapshots + jemalloc arena/pinned-span analysis), and long-term: GC/allocator tuning & better fragmentation metrics.

lin: I'll own the short-term guardrail behind a flag. Plan: introduce `runtime.compact.max_concurrent=2` and abort if host_free_pct < 11%. Feature-flagged dark launch then canary. ETA 16h.

devon: I'll add instrumentation: compact:start/stop traces, per-shard live-pages, jemalloc stats export (allocated, active, narenas pinned). Also will run normalized repro and collect flamegraphs. PR wip.

ash: Please add a dashboard panel comparing compaction.rate vs host.free_pages and jemalloc.active/allocated ratio. We need backfill for 60 days.

sre-bot: Ticket INF-3399 created: "ooms: compaction -> pinned spans / fragmentation" assigned to lin, devon, mira. Priority: P1. Link: https://tickets/internal/INF-3399

cooper: Owners & quick timeline:
- Lin: feature-flag cap + rollout doc / due 16h
- Devon: instrumentation + repro runs / due 48h
- Mira: full RCA + backfill metrics / due 5d
- Ash: coordinate canary & capacity ops / due 24h

devon: Example repro commands:
```
./repro_harness --qps=45 --duration=40m --compact-interval=30s --heap-profiler=sampling
scripts/collect_jeprof.sh --out=/tmp/jeprof.compact
```

mira: RCA checklist: heapshots pre/during/post compact, jemalloc stats diff, check for pinned spans (jeprof/je_stat), look for recent allocator or compaction heuristic patches in last 6 weeks.

lin: Rollout plan: dark metrics for 12h (flag on, no abort), canary on 2 hosts with abort enabled for 24h -> expand. Rollback = flip flag + drain compactions.

ash: Add alert: fire when compaction.abort_count>2 in 10m OR host.free_pct<9% during compaction windows.

devon: Status: instrumentation PR opened, waiting review. Need permission for 2h staging long-run. Blocker: staging quota.

mira: Status: starting backfill tonight for kv.compact.* and jemalloc.active/allocated. Will post initial diffs by EOD tomorrow.

cooper: Schedule follow-up demo (owners mira+devon) to show RCA and candidate fixes. Target: 2025-01-21.

lin: Quick note: if fragmentation looks systemic we may try jemalloc tunables (lg_chunk, decay) as an intermediate mitigation — keep as contingency.

ash: Daily updates here until INF-3399 closed. Keep them short (done / blocker). Ping me for urgent escalations. :thumbsup:
